heading.en: A whole amplifier in a tiny chip

hook.en: The IC 741 costs less than a samosa, yet it holds about twenty transistors. With two resistors it becomes an amplifier of any gain you want.
hook.kn: IC 741 ಒಂದು ಸಮೋಸಾಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಅಗ್ಗ, ಆದರೂ ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ಟ್ರಾನ್ಸಿಸ್ಟರ್‌ಗಳಿವೆ. ಎರಡು ರೋಧಕಗಳಿಂದ ಅದು ಬೇಕಾದ ವರ್ಧನೆಯ ವರ್ಧಕವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Explain differential and common-mode gain and CMRR
Draw the block diagram of an op-amp

narration.en: The IC 741 costs less than a samosa, yet it holds about twenty transistors. With two resistors it becomes an amplifier of any gain you want.
narration.kn: IC 741 ಒಂದು ಸಮೋಸಾಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಅಗ್ಗ, ಆದರೂ ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ಟ್ರಾನ್ಸಿಸ್ಟರ್‌ಗಳಿವೆ. ಎರಡು ರೋಧಕಗಳಿಂದ ಅದು ಬೇಕಾದ ವರ್ಧನೆಯ ವರ್ಧಕವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: A differential amplifier has two inputs and amplifies their difference. With inputs $V_1$ and $V_2$, the difference signal is $V_d = V_1 - V_2$ and the common-mode signal is $V_c = (V_1 + V_2)/2$. The output is $V_o = A_dV_d + A_cV_c$, where $A_d$ is the differential gain and $A_c$ the (small) common-mode gain. The common-mode rejection ratio $\text{CMRR} = A_d/A_c$, often in dB, measures how well signals common to both inputs, such as hum and noise, are rejected. Ideally $A_c = 0$ and CMRR is infinite.

narration.en: A differential amplifier amplifies the difference of its two inputs and rejects what is common to both. CMRR is the ratio of differential to common-mode gain.
narration.kn: ಡಿಫರೆನ್ಷಿಯಲ್ ವರ್ಧಕ ಎರಡು ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗಳ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ವರ್ಧಿಸಿ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. CMRR = Ad/Ac.

title.en: The op-amp: symbol, pins and inside

narration.en: On the board: the op-amp: symbol, pins and inside.

say.en: The op-amp has two inputs: inverting at pin 2 and non-inverting at pin 3. Output is pin 6; plus and minus supplies go to pins 7 and 4.
Inside are four direct-coupled stages: a differential input stage, more gain, a level shifter and a push-pull output.

text.en: 3 Shifter: brings DC level to 0 V

say.en: The output depends mainly on the difference of the inputs. The common-mode rejection ratio tells how well the common part is rejected.

body.en: An operational amplifier is a very high gain, direct-coupled differential amplifier. Its block diagram has a differential input stage (high input resistance and CMRR), an intermediate gain stage, a level shifter that brings the DC level back to zero, and a push-pull output stage (low output resistance). Being direct-coupled, it amplifies DC as well as AC. In the 8-pin IC 741: pin 2 inverting input, pin 3 non-inverting input, pin 6 output, pin 7 +VCC, pin 4 −VEE, pins 1 and 5 offset null, pin 8 no connection.

points.en: Stages: differential input, gain, level shifter, output

narration.en: The op-amp has a differential input stage, a gain stage, a level shifter and an output stage. In the 741, pins two and three are inputs and pin six is the output.
narration.kn: ಆಪ್-ಆಂಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಡಿಫರೆನ್ಷಿಯಲ್ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಹಂತ, ವರ್ಧನಾ ಹಂತ, ಮಟ್ಟ ಸ್ಥಳಾಂತರಕ ಮತ್ತು ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಹಂತಗಳಿವೆ. 741 ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಿನ್ 2, 3 ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್, ಪಿನ್ 6 ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್.

steps.en: The common-mode part (2 mV) is an error of 20%: this CMRR is poor.

homework.en: Draw the block diagram of an op-amp and the pin diagram of IC 741.

narration.en: Recap. Op-amp: high-gain, direct-coupled differential amplifier. Vo = Ad(V1 − V2) + Ac(V1 + V2)/2. CMRR = Ad/Ac; ideally infinite. 741 pins: 2 (−), 3 (+), 6 out, 7 +VCC, 4 −VEE.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಆಪ್-ಆಂಪ್: ಹೆಚ್ಚು ವರ್ಧನೆಯ, ನೇರ ಜೋಡಣೆಯ ಡಿಫರೆನ್ಷಿಯಲ್ ವರ್ಧಕ. Vo = Ad(V1 − V2) + Ac(V1 + V2)/2. CMRR = Ad/Ac; ಆದರ್ಶವಾಗಿ ಅನಂತ. 741 ಪಿನ್‌ಗಳು: 2 (−), 3 (+), 6 ಔಟ್, 7 +VCC, 4 −VEE.
